mapper.update: INSERT INTO partition_visit_stat_business(table_name, partition_name, visit_count) VALUES (#{tableName}, #{partitionName}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_count = visit_count + 1

INSERT INTO partition_visit_stat_business(table_name, partition_name, visit_count, last_moved_time) VALUES (#{tableName}, #{partitionName}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visit_count = 0, last_moved_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM partition_visit_stat_business WHERE table_name = #{tableName} AND partition_name = #{partitionName}

SELECT PARTITION_NAME as partition_name FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_NAME = #{tableName} AND TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND PARTITION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND PARTITION_NAME NOT IN ('p_future', 'p_cold_init')

SELECT PARTITION_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS WHERE TABLE_NAME = #{tableName} AND TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND PARTITION_NAME IS NOT NULL AND PARTITION_DESCRIPTION <> 'MAXVALUE' AND CAST(PARTITION_DESCRIPTION AS UNSIGNED) > TO_DAYS(#{dataTime}) ORDER BY PARTITION_ORDINAL_POSITION LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO ${coldTableName} SELECT * FROM ${hotTableName} PARTITION (${partitionName})
INSERT IGNORE INTO ${hotTableName} SELECT * FROM ${coldTableName} PARTITION (${partitionName})
